```{r}
# get in data
library(data.table)
dt <- fread("Shared_Micromobility_Vehicle_Trips_(2018-2022).csv", nThread = 4)
```

```{r}
# sample range in 200k
library(dplyr)

set.seed(123)
dt_sample <- dt %>% sample_n(200000)
```

```{r}
# select lines
dt_sample <- dt_sample %>% 
  select(
    ID,
    `Vehicle Type`,
    `Trip Duration`,
    `Trip Distance`,
    `Start Time`,
    `End Time`,
    Month,
    Hour,
    `Day of Week`
  )
```

```{r}
# secs -> minutes
dt_sample$`Trip Duration` <- gsub(",", "", dt_sample$`Trip Duration`)
dt_sample$`Trip Duration` <- as.numeric(dt_sample$`Trip Duration`)

dt_sample$duration_min <- dt_sample$`Trip Duration` / 60
dt_sample <- dt_sample[
  dt_sample$duration_min <= quantile(dt_sample$duration_min, 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)]
```

```{r}
# m -> km
dt_sample$`Trip Distance` <- gsub(",", "", dt_sample$`Trip Distance`)
dt_sample$`Trip Distance` <- as.numeric(dt_sample$`Trip Distance`)

dt_sample$distance_km <- dt_sample$`Trip Distance` / 1000
dt_sample <- dt_sample[
  dt_sample$distance_km <= quantile(dt_sample$distance_km, 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)]
```

```{r}
# check
summary(dt_sample$duration_min)
summary(dt_sample$distance_km)
```

```{r}
# vehicle type factor
dt_sample$vehicle_type <- factor(dt_sample$`Vehicle Type`)
```

```{r}
# factor：1–7 -> Mon–Sun
dt_sample$weekday <- factor(
  dt_sample$`Day of Week`,
  levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,0),
  labels = c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun")
)
```

```{r}
# month factor
dt_sample$month <- factor(dt_sample$Month, levels = 1:12)
```

```{r}
# Hour factor
dt_sample$hour <- as.numeric(dt_sample$Hour)
```

```{r}
# log(duration)
dt_sample$log_duration <- log(dt_sample$duration_min)
```

```{r}
# start time
dt_sample$start_time <- as.POSIXct(
  dt_sample$`Start Time`,
  format = "%Y %b %d %I:%M:%S %p",
  tz = "US/Central"
)
```

```{r}
# end time
dt_sample$end_time <- as.POSIXct(
  dt_sample$`End Time`,
  format = "%Y %b %d %I:%M:%S %p",
  tz = "US/Central"
)
```

```{r}
# clean
trips_clean <- dt_sample %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(duration_min),
    duration_min > 0,
    !is.na(distance_km),
    distance_km > 0,
    !is.na(start_time),
    !is.na(end_time),
    !is.na(vehicle_type),
    !is.na(hour),
    !is.na(weekday)
  )
```

```{r}
dim(trips_clean)
summary(trips_clean$duration_min)
summary(trips_clean$log_duration)
table(trips_clean$vehicle_type)
```

```{r}
hist(trips_clean$duration_min, breaks = 50,
     main = "Trip duration (min)", xlab = "Minutes")

hist(trips_clean$log_duration, breaks = 50,
     main = "Log trip duration", xlab = "log(minutes)")
```

# Multiple Linear Regression

```{r}
fit <- lm(log_duration ~ distance_km + hour + weekday + vehicle_type,
          data = trips_clean)

summary(fit)
```

# Stepwise / AIC

```{r}
library(MASS)

fit_full <- lm(log_duration ~ distance_km + hour + weekday + vehicle_type,
               data = trips_clean)

fit_step <- stepAIC(fit_full, direction = "both")

summary(fit_step)
```

# Add the distance_km\^2

```{r}
fit_quad <- lm(log_duration ~ distance_km + I(distance_km^2) + hour + weekday + vehicle_type,
               data = trips_clean)
summary(fit_quad)
```

# distance to log(distance)

```{r}
fit_logdist <- lm(log_duration ~ log(distance_km+0.001) + hour + weekday + vehicle_type,
                  data = trips_clean)
summary(fit_logdist)
```

# Add interaction

```{r}
fit_int <- lm(log_duration ~ distance_km * vehicle_type + hour + weekday,
              data = trips_clean)
summary(fit_int)
```

# Diagnostic Plots

# Residuals vs Fitted

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

diag_df <- augment(fit_quad)

ggplot(diag_df, aes(.fitted, .resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted",
       x = "Fitted values",
       y = "Residuals")
```

# Normal Q-Q plot

```{r}
ggplot(diag_df, aes(sample = .std.resid)) +
  stat_qq(alpha = 0.3) +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q Plot")
```

# Scale-Location

```{r}
ggplot(diag_df, aes(.fitted, sqrt(abs(.std.resid)))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Scale-Location Plot",
       y = "√|Standardized residuals|")
```

# Residuals vs Leverage

```{r}
ggplot(diag_df, aes(.hat, .std.resid)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Leverage",
       x = "Leverage",
       y = "Standardized residuals")
```

# Train/Test Split

# create train/test split

```{r}
set.seed(123)

n <- nrow(trips_clean)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.8 * n)

train <- trips_clean[train_idx, ]
test  <- trips_clean[-train_idx, ]
```

# 在train上拟合模型

```{r}
fit_train <- lm(log_duration ~ distance_km + I(distance_km^2) + hour + weekday + vehicle_type,
                data = train)
```

# 对test数据预测

```{r}
pred <- predict(fit_train, newdata = test)
```

#RMSE

```{r}
rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$log_duration - pred)^2))
rmse
```

# Test R\^2

```{r}
sst <- sum((test$log_duration - mean(test$log_duration))^2)
sse <- sum((test$log_duration - pred)^2)
test_r2 <- 1 - sse/sst
test_r2
```

# 模型比较

```{r}
# collect models
models <- list(
  baseline   = fit_full,
  quadratic  = fit_quad,
  logdist    = fit_logdist,
  interaction = fit_int
)

# function to extract metrics
get_metrics <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)
  c(
    AIC      = AIC(m),
    RSE      = s$sigma,              # residual standard error
    R2       = s$r.squared,
    Adj_R2   = s$adj.r.squared
  )
}

# build comparison table
cmp <- t(sapply(models, get_metrics))
cmp <- round(cmp, 4)
cmp
```

```{r}
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)

```

# Partial effect for distance

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# choose reference values
ref_hour    <- mean(trips_clean$hour, na.rm = TRUE)
ref_weekday <- levels(trips_clean$weekday)[1]       # usually "Mon"
ref_vtype   <- levels(trips_clean$vehicle_type)[1]  # 挑一个你喜欢的 baseline

# distance range
dist_seq <- seq(
  quantile(trips_clean$distance_km, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(trips_clean$distance_km, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

new_dat <- data.frame(
  distance_km = dist_seq,
  hour        = ref_hour,
  weekday     = factor(ref_weekday, levels = levels(trips_clean$weekday)),
  vehicle_type = factor(ref_vtype, levels = levels(trips_clean$vehicle_type))
)

new_dat$pred_log <- predict(fit_quad, newdata = new_dat)
new_dat$pred_min <- exp(new_dat$pred_log)

plot(new_dat$distance_km, new_dat$pred_min,
     type = "l",
     xlab = "Distance (km)",
     ylab = "Predicted duration (min)",
     main = sprintf("Effect of distance on duration\n(%s, %s, hour = %.1f)",
                    ref_weekday, ref_vtype, ref_hour))
```

# Interaction 可视化：distance × vehicle_type（用 fit_int）

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# distance range
dist_seq <- seq(
  quantile(trips_clean$distance_km, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE),
  quantile(trips_clean$distance_km, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 100
)

# fix other vars
ref_hour    <- mean(trips_clean$hour, na.rm = TRUE)
ref_weekday <- levels(trips_clean$weekday)[1]

# build grid for each vehicle type
grid <- expand.grid(
  distance_km = dist_seq,
  vehicle_type = levels(trips_clean$vehicle_type),
  hour = ref_hour,
  weekday = factor(ref_weekday, levels = levels(trips_clean$weekday))
)

grid$pred_log <- predict(fit_int, newdata = grid)
grid$pred_min <- exp(grid$pred_log)

ggplot(grid, aes(x = distance_km, y = pred_min, color = vehicle_type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted duration vs distance by vehicle type",
    x = "Distance (km)",
    y = "Predicted duration (min)",
    color = "Vehicle type"
  )
```
